scope: offline long-only Strict-R3 :00-only research; no live, canonical, exchange, admission, portfolio, or execution artifact modified
purpose: Correct Stage-2 residual runner contracts before any valid layer-two artifact is accepted: R2 is the declared three-class residual-direction head, R3 satisfies the shallow Huber depth cap, and first-pass layer-two outputs have late-MC1 evidence only.

contracts.r2_target: r2 <= -100 bps is adverse; -100 < r2 < +100 bps is weak; r2 >= +100 bps is clear; score=P(clear)-0.5*P(adverse).
contracts.r3_capacity: HistGradientBoostingRegressor Huber maximum depth is 3 with the existing high leaf and regularization constraints.
contracts.fusion: No layer-two output receives upstream or final-score authority in the initial pass. Early bounded authority may be tested only after a late-evidence survivor passes its Stage-2 gates.
contracts.causality: Layer-two fitting remains restricted to labels resolved before each preceding 28-day reserve and consumes only strict-OOF layer-one/Delta1 inputs.
